---
name: Research finding
about: Propose an evidence-backed interpretation or document uncertainty
title: "[Research] "
---

## Firmware identity and addresses
Revision, SHA-256, image size/base; function/RAM/ROM addresses.

## Claim and confidence
Native fact, bounded model, hardware observation, inherited label or hypothesis?

## Evidence and reproduction
Exact tools/versions, inputs, expected/observed behavior, references.
Use small necessary excerpts, not a complete firmware image or private capture.

## Limits and next falsifiable check
Which branches, hardware behavior or units remain unverified?

## Attribution
Original source and license; disclose AI assistance and actual verification.
